description: This file defines a custom exception class named InvalidAmountOfCollaterals for the loan account module in the Fineract project. It extends an abstract exception class and is used to signal errors related to collateral amount validation.

classes.name: InvalidAmountOfCollaterals
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the collateral amount is invalid, specifically when its total value does not meet the required condition.

methods.name: InvalidAmountOfCollaterals
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating the total collateral value failed the validation. It constructs a message including the amount.

methods.name: InvalidAmountOfCollaterals
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom user message, entity, and message arguments for the exception.
